research.driverType:
This is Kyocera's own v3 'KX' printer driver: a vendor monolithic GDI driver with proprietary model data.

It is NOT any of the Microsoft-based types:
- not v3 Unidrv: no GPD and no UNIDRV.DLL
- not v3 PostScript: no PPD and no PSCRIPT5.DLL
- not v4: no ClassVer=4.0, no PrinterDriverID, no v4 manifest, no JavaScript constraints

Evidence from the 64bit files:
- DriverFile KMUC879H.DLL (x64) exports DrvEnableDriver, DrvQueryDriverInfo and DrvDisableDriver.
- ConfigFile KMUU879H.DLL exports DrvDeviceCapabilities, DrvDocumentPropertySheets, DrvDevicePropertySheets, DrvConvertDevMode, DrvDocumentEvent, DrvDriverEvent, DrvPrinterEvent, DrvUpgradePrinter, DevQueryPrintEx and MxdcGetPDEVAdjustment.
- [Version] has DriverIsolation=2, which Microsoft documents as meaning the driver supports driver isolation.
- [PrinterPackageInstallation.amd64] has PackageAware=TRUE.

There is ONE driver per model. Both brands use the same brand-neutral name under the manufacturer 'TA/UTAX', and there are no separate PCL or KPDL INF entries. The page description language is chosen inside the driver:
- P-4531DN and P-5032DN XML: <PDL><type>XPS</type><type>PCL XL 3.0*</type><type>PCL 5E</type><type>KPDL3.0</type></PDL>. The '*' marks the default, PCL XL.
- P-4030DN: the PDL list is UNVERIFIED because its model data is a binary MDX file. The ALLPDL copy section (KMXL879H.DLL, KM5E879H.DLL, KM5C879H.DLL, KMPS879H.DLL, KMPD879H.DLL) is shared by all models.

The official TA site lists a separate 'KX XPS Universal Print Driver (KXv4)' v6.1.1603 (Kxv4_v6.1.1603_TA_RC7_WHQL.zip). I did not analyze it.

Weak warning on the P-5032DN hardware ID (UNVERIFIED). The last 4 hex digits of UTAX_TAP-4030DN1652 and UTAX_TAP-4531DND6CF equal a standard 16-bit checksum (CRC-16/ARC) of 'UTAX_TAP-4030DN' and 'UTAX_TAP-4531DN'. This is not a refutation: the same checksum test fails for 104 of the 194 IDs in the INF, Microsoft says the OS checksum 'may not match ... any other CRC algorithm' (learn.microsoft.com, Identifiers Generated by USBPRINT.SYS), and TA's 2019 PCL5 INF uses the same ID.
